scenes.title:
Your flight.
Your choice.
lines: A more consistent start to every session
scenes.narration: This update gives you a clearer choice between Normal and Experimental releases, while keeping your simulator display settings in your hands.

scenes.title: Choose. Check. Install.
lines: Normal includes alpha updates with frame generation Off
Experimental includes frame generation development options
scenes.narration: Open Updates and Channel. Choose Normal for the recommended configuration, or Experimental to test frame generation. Your choice is remembered. Select Switch and install to change builds.

scenes.title: Start with familiar menus.
lines: Launch keeps current output and window mode
UI size and font remain controlled by X-Plane
Select a preset or Apply graphics to change output
scenes.narration: Launching now keeps your current output and window mode. Set menu and font size in X Plane. To change output deliberately, select a preset or click Apply graphics before launching.

scenes.title: Stay in control.
lines: Experimental frame generation remains a testing feature
Return to Normal from the same channel selector
Skip this guide immediately, or replay from What’s new
scenes.narration: Experimental frame generation remains a testing feature. Return to Normal from the same selector. Installation waits for your click with X Plane closed. Skip this guide whenever you like, or replay it from Whats New.

edition: Maintenance package reusing the previously owner-approved 0.6.4 guide unchanged
